messages:
morgan: Quick sync — who owns attribution for KV prefix-cache hits for cost reporting? RFC left this open: attach billing_key at the edge, or resolve in enrichment later?

tara: I'd vote edge attach. late enrichment loses events when sampling kicks in and that skews unit economics. :thinking:

sahil: edge attach is correct for fidelity but cardinality explosion risk. can we attach a compact hint instead of the full billing key? e.g. hashed tenant id.

lee: hashing is fine but needs a stable salt per-tenant so same tenant maps to same shard. also what do we do for anonymous/no-tenant flows?

ana: (Ops) attaching at edge impacts proxy headers/latency. our 95p proxy SLO is tight. can we keep it tiny (<=64 bytes) and make full resolution async?

morgan: Proposal: edge emits a small `X-Billing-Hint` header with a tenant id or stable hash and a `X-Billing-Mode: hint` flag. enrichment service does full lookup later and emits final billing_key if resolved. if not resolved, attribute to `unknown`.

sahil: sample header:
```
X-Billing-Hint: tenant=acme;h=sha256:3f5b...
X-Billing-Mode: hint
```
we should document TTL for hint-to-tenant mapping and rotation policy for salts.

tara: fallback/backfill policy: when enrichment resolves later we should backfill the cost attribution in billing pipeline. need idempotency keys to avoid double-counting.

morgan: agreed. use `billing_hint_hash` (the h=...) as the join key in the pipeline so enrichment can update attribution. pipeline must dedupe by event_id + billing_hint_hash. @ops-bot any thoughts on backfill cost?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Backfill join is supported but expensive at scale. rough estimate: 1B events -> 2-3 hour Spark job. Recommend limiting backfill window to 7 days by default.

lee: also: sampling interaction — if an event is sampled out before enrichment, we lose it permanently. so make hint required on all ingested telemetry to avoid sampling loss.

ana: also: proxy must enforce max header length and strip `X-Billing-Hint` before forwarding to external downstreams. Security: don't leak tenant identifiers.

morgan: Next actions: 1) DevEx doc with header schema + examples (tara) 2) Proxy change to attach hint & enforce header length + strip outbound (ana) 3) Enrichment join + backfill window + dedupe logic (sahil + ops) 4) Ingest metrics schema update: add `billing_hint_hash` field (morgan)

tara: SG — I'll open a follow-up RFC PR with the header schema and a small example payload.

morgan: thanks all — will coordinate owners on the PR. :thumbsup:
